> [!WARNING]
> ### 🚫 Closed Contribution Policy
> As outlined in our [Contribution Policy](CONTRIBUTING.md), Vermeil maintains a **Closed Contribution Policy** to preserve architectural cohesion and project focus.
>
> **We do not accept external pull requests, automated dependency bumps, or unsolicited code contributions.** Pull requests are closed without review.
>
> If you wish to customize Vermeil, add new features, or experiment with the codebase, you are warmly encouraged to **[fork the repository](https://github.com/VermeilDev/Vermeil-Launcher/fork)** under the terms of the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE).
